name: biblio-library-empty
comment: Slice 2 runtime proof (plan 2026-08-06-biblio-library-tab-theatre-parity.md). In a DISPOSABLE, unseeded lanista session the Library tab is present, clickable, retained across a tab round-trip, and shows its empty-state surface with rowCount 0. Unseeded => tagged AppData root has no Collection entries => allRows is [] by construction (no network, no seeding). Run via `lanista session run ... --drive --tag biblio_lib_empty`. NOTE on objectNames: Biblio's tab pills are biblioTab_<key>, NOT worldTab_<key> — WorldTabBar.tabPrefix is set to 'biblioTab' in BiblioWorld because the default 'worldTab' stem collides with Tankoban's pills (Tankoban is pre-warmed by a boot timer and resolveTarget's DFS walks hidden worlds too, so worldTab_library resolved to Tankoban's pill and ate Biblio's click — fixed 2026-08-06). Race-hardening: the retained Discover page loads a network catalog in the background; we wait for that load to settle (loading==false) BEFORE clicking Library so no deferred catalog work races the assertion. Verb notes: ui-query returns a FIXED shape {rect,visible,enabled,opacity,clippedByWindow} (visible is real); qml-get reads arbitrary named props (rowCount).

steps.label: session app answers on its own pipe with drive armed
the boot splash has left the screen
Biblio's tab bar appears (3 tabs: Discover/Explore/Library)
let the retained Discover catalog load settle so no deferred work races the Library assertion
click the Library tab (biblioTab-scoped, no Tankoban collision)
the Library page is on screen
page is visible (ui-query's native visible field)
the no-match state is NOT showing (no query typed)
round-trip: click Library again (retention proof — page survives)
Library page is back and retained
